signature: SUBROUTINE DPPCON( UPLO, N, AP, ANORM, RCOND, WORK, IWORK, INFO )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference: The triangular factor U or L from the Cholesky factorization $A = U^T \, U$ or $A = L \, L^T$, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of U or L is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = U(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2n-j)/2) = L(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

params.name: anorm
params.reference: The 1-norm (or infinity-norm) of the symmetric matrix A.

params.name: rcond
params.reference: The reciprocal of the condition number of the matrix A, computed as $\mathrm{RCOND} = 1/(\mathrm{ANORM} \, \mathrm{AINVNM})$, where AINVNM is an estimate of the 1-norm of inv(A) computed in this routine.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
